#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using ii = pair<int,int>;

constexpr int MAX_FLOW_VAL = (1<<29);

struct Edge {
    int v;
    int f;
    int c;
    int next;
};

Edge E[2 * MAX_E];
int head[MAX_N], ptr[MAX_N], lvl[MAX_N], Q[MAX_N];
int num_edges, num_nodes, source, sink, qf, qb;

inline void init_graph(int n, int s, int d) {
    num_nodes = n;
    source = s;
    sink = d;
    num_edges = 2;
    memset(head, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + 1));
}

inline void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
    E[num_edges] = {v, 0, cap, head[u]};
    head[u] = num_edges++;
    E[num_edges] = {u, 0, 0, head[v]};
    head[v] = num_edges++;
}

inline bool bfs_level() {
    memset(lvl, 0, sizeof(int) * (num_nodes + 1));
    qf = qb = 0;
    Q[qb++] = source;
    lvl[source] = 1;
    while (qf < qb && !lvl[sink]) {
        int u = Q[qf++];
        for (int e = head[u]; e; e = E[e].next) {
            int v = E[e].v;
            if (!lvl[v] && E[e].f < E[e].c) {
                lvl[v] = lvl[u] + 1;
                Q[qb++] = v;
            }
        }
    }
    return lvl[sink];
}

inline int dfs(int u, int f) {
    if (u == sink) return f;
    for (int &e = ptr[u]; e; e = ptr[u] = E[e].next) {
        int v = E[e].v;

            E[e].f += f;
            E[e ^ 1].f -= f;
            return f;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline int dinic() {
    int ret = 0, df;
    while (bfs_level()) {
        copy(head, head + num_nodes + 1, ptr);
        while ((df = dfs(source, MAX_FLOW_VAL))) ret += df;
    }
    return ret;
}
